title: Browser assertion claims
description: The JWT payload of the assertion a Personal Agent's browser posts to web.browser_session_endpoint. Spec section 5 (Web browsing). The JWT header has typ poppy-browser+jwt. exp is no more than 60 seconds after iat, and return_to is on the Company's organization.domain, and jkt is the RFC 7638 thumbprint of the Session Key; those are checked separately.
